title: nan
authors: Suzuki S.; Min H.; Wada T.; Nonami K.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated EKF navigation system for aerial robots operating seamlessly in GPS and GPS-denied environments using GPS and LiDAR, verified by simulation and experiment.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
